formal_statement: ∀ s : ℕ, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize 5 (fun x : Fin 5 → Bool => (x 0 && x 1) || (x 2 && x 3) || (x 3 && x 4) || (x 2 && x 4)) s ↔ 6 ≤ s
plain_statement: The graph on vertices 0 to 4 with edges 0-1, 2-3, 3-4, 2-4 (a triangle and a disjoint edge; 4 edges, least vertex cover 3). Its edge function on 5 inputs, x0 x1 OR x2 x3 OR x3 x4 OR x2 x4, true when both ends of some edge are true, has a circuit of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in at most two (every gate counted) with at most s gates exactly when s >= 6.
title: Exact circuit size: the edge function of a triangle and a disjoint edge has circuits with s gates exactly when s >= 6
